## Funnel signals

| Signal | Value |
|---|---|
| Applications sent |  |
| Outreach messages sent |  |
| Response rate (outreach, cohort window elapsed) |  |
| Screen rate (applications) |  |
| Screen-to-rejection ratio |  |
| Technical interviews reached |  |
| Compensation mismatches (by market) |  |

## Conversion by cohort

- By lane (France / Web3 infrastructure / Berlin), never pooled
- By employer tier (A / B / C)
- By channel (outreach / ATS / recruiter)
- By evidence version (pre-project / early Python / completed Python / Go)

## Adaptation thresholds (docs/search-plan.md §7)

- [ ] Outreach response < 10% after 3 active weeks → change targeting OR messaging (one at a time)
- [ ] Screen-to-rejection > 75% after 4 active weeks → classify rejections, narrow the band or the pre-qualification
- [ ] Zero technical interviews after 6 weeks of active ATS applications → pause new ATS applications for one week, audit the funnel
- [ ] Compensation mismatch > 50% of rejections in a market → research that market's band
- [ ] One lane below another after 4 comparable active weeks → shift 10 points; never abandon a lane on a small cohort
- [ ] An admissible Tier C bridge above €70k with AI exposure → pursue it as a strategic bridge
